compilation.runtime: compile-only; guest execution is a separate qualification

limitations: The native Cargo case oracle has one exact platform-specific replacement, preserving rejection of unpinned developer targets; the shared-memory allocation ABI remains pinned to x86_64.
The user-mode failure record is a diagnostic execution on the build host. Passing qualification uses a real target kernel in a Nix-sandboxed QEMU system VM with no network interface.
This does not qualify a complete foreign application, foreign editor workflow, Darwin, or the reverse execution/target pairing.
A separate foreign Cargo feature oracle was not run; case discovery is compared against the qualified native oracle with the declared platform replacement.
Correctness qualification does not establish performance budgets or authorize a production package cutover.
